name: genpark-enterprise-data-lineage-impact-graph-analyzer-skill
description: Enterprise Data Lineage & Schema Change Blast-Radius Impact Analyzer. Constructs column- and table-level Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) across Tencent Cloud Data Warehouses, Tencent Docs spreadsheets, and BI executive dashboards, performs upstream provenance and downstream blast-radius traversal, and renders Mermaid lineage diagrams.

tools.name: analyze_enterprise_data_lineage
tools.description: Register data pipeline edges, trace upstream data provenance, compute downstream schema change blast radius, and render Mermaid lineage diagrams.

edges.description: List of lineage edges [source, target, transformation_type, criticality].

target_node.description: Node ID to inspect for impact or provenance.
